name: article-templates-app
title: Article templates
description: Allows you to create and manage article templates, create a template from an existing article, and create new articles from templates to streamline your Knowledge Base workflow.
changeNotes:
Version 1.4.0

  • Apply Template In Place: The "Apply article template" widget now fills in the current draft instead of creating another draft in a new tab.
  • Only the template has to be selected: the project is taken from the draft itself and the template list is filtered by it.
  • A draft that already has a summary or content shows a warning before the template replaces them.
  • The action is also available while a published article is edited. There the template is applied and saved immediately, and the widget warns about it upfront.

Version 1.3.0

  • Apply Template Widget: Added a new widget in the article draft options menu that allows you to quickly apply a template to an existing article draft.
